title: Finite genuine W32 one-anchored-row exact pair-D6 probability census
statement: At the single finite original W(3,2) model and frozen full globally injected original left-point maps S68 and S72, for one fixed genuine original incidence set Q0=(0,5,7,10,13,39), the set of left connected C6 candidate ORIGINAL six-incidence Q1 has exactly 21186 elements. The anchored joint D6 expectation row under ONE uniform full global original line injection g contains 112 cyclic original-line gluing signatures, 6192 strictly positive pair probabilities, 14994 zero probabilities and exact sum over Q1 of P_g(D6(Q0) and D6(Q1)|f)=19457/10810800. Consequently E_g[D6(f,g)|D6(Q0),f]=19457/2160 for this frozen row. Genuine Q1 with r=2 shared original line factors can have either compatible positive or provably zero joint probability according to tau. This is ONE anchored row, not the FULL 21186 by 21186 pair matrix nor a second moment of D6.

quantifiers.domain: integer h=1, s=2^h=2; single FINITE ORIGINAL W(3,2) only
f is either documented full original point map S68 or S72 and Q0=(0,5,7,10,13,39) actual six-incidence anchor
all 21186 valid original Q1 and exact uniform complete global source-line map g distribution counted by canonical signatures, not a new all-h theorem

external_dependencies: Independent finite genuine W(3,2) source Q enumeration, historical seven-class original GF5 D6 classifier and canonical dihedral cycle signature oracle in source PR #487.
Research PR #485 independently records source-line-overlap row count for predecessor; exact finite S68/S72 joint checker is pinned source not independently replayed by catalog import.
limitations: An anchored row is not the full conditional E_g[D6(f,g)^2] summed over all Q0,Q1 and is not a variance or covariance of total D6.
Finite W(3,2) witness cannot certify an all-h universal positive all-f,g lower bound or an infinite counterfamily.
All counts are tied to genuine original source incidence IDs, a single complete globally injected f and one coherent uniformly random complete g.
falsification_boundary: The anchor and Q1 must be real six-distinct ORIGINAL W(3,2) incidence IDs with true source-line overlap; preserve the fixed full original global f, and do not replace exact line cycle signatures with r-only bins.
